title: Tax rounds down instead of half up
prompt: An invoice of 19.99 EUR at 7% tax shows 1.39 tax; the correct amount is 1.40 (139.93 cents rounds half up to 140). The percentage helper in src/domain/money.ts truncates. Make it round half up to the nearest cent, add a test with the 1999 cents case, and make sure the discount ladder still passes its tests.
